Built-in NFC chips launch a preset app when you tap an NFC-enabled phone on the car mount. Three NFC shortcuts can be switched between for a convenient experience.
The MagSafe car mount charges your phone at a fast speed of up to 15W.
Integrated premium MagSafe magnets hold a MagSafe-enabled phone securely and keep wireless charging stable, even on bumpy roads.

Qi2 is the latest generation of wireless charging standards, with improved efficiency, faster 15W charging and broad compatibility with iPhone and Android phones. Certification brings all of that to this magnetic car mount.
